summary: Coach is a cloud platform system that improves VM packing by exploiting temporal resource-usage patterns to oversubscribe CPU and memory across virtual machines. This figure illustrates three CoachVMs (CVM1, CVM2, CVM3) hosted on one server, each with declared core and memory sizes split into a guaranteed portion (always reserved) and an oversubscribed portion (shared with other CVMs). Small per-CVM boxes show cores and memory colored by whether they are underutilized, utilized-guaranteed, or utilized-oversubscribed, following the legend at top. Below, a Server-level table aggregates the same cores and memory rows across all three CVMs, separating the always-available Guaranteed capacity from the smaller, shared Oversubscribed pool highlighted in yellow, showing how 10 cores and 36GB back VMs that nominally need 14 cores and 56GB.
